_about: Approval page shapes for license_signin.classify_page and the browser steps that use it.
Copied from pages recorded live during the License Switching mission, with every name replaced by a made-up one
(alice@example.com is the account being approved, bob@example.com is someone else) and the long cookie notice cut.
consent: the authorize page with the Authorize button; its opening lines were recorded on 13 October 2026 (the rest of its
list was cut off in the recording) and its 'Logged in as' line is the one the approval tool reads on every approval.
signed-out: claude.ai's sign-in page, recorded on 14 October 2026 when an approver browser had no session.
reauth-on-authorize: the authorize page asking for a recent sign-in, recorded on 13 October 2026 in a browser
whose claude.ai chat worked (the 16 October report, problem 12).
reauth-login: the same request seen as a redirect to claude.ai/login?reauth=1, recorded on 13 and 14 October 2026.
Each page has the address the browser was at, the text of the page, and whether an Authorize button was on screen.
